description: A comprehensive, production-ready Entity Framework Core library providing Repository pattern, Unit of Work, Specification pattern, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), Aggregate Roots, Value Objects, Business Rules, Domain Events, dynamic filtering, pagination support, Fluent Configuration API, robust interceptor system, and modular ID generation strategies for enterprise .NET applications.
releaseNotes:
Version 10.0.2 - Comprehensive Projection Support & New Features

🚀 NEW FEATURES:

PROJECTION/SELECT SUPPORT:
- GetByIdAsync<TResult>(id, selector) - Project single entity by ID
- GetAllAsync<TResult>(selector) - Project all entities
- FirstOrDefaultAsync<TResult>(predicate, selector) - Project first match
- SingleOrDefaultAsync<TResult>(predicate, selector) - Project single match (throws if multiple)
- FindAsync<TResult>(predicate, selector, orderBy) - Project filtered results
- GetPagedAsync<TResult>(selector, ...) - Paginated projections
- GetPagedWithFilterAsync<TResult>(selector, ...) - Filtered pagination with projection
- GetAsync<TResult>(spec, selector) - Specification with projection

SPECIFICATION ENHANCEMENTS:
- ApplySelector<TResult>() - Define projection in specification
- Include<TProperty>() with ThenInclude chaining - Type-safe nested eager loading
- IncludeCollection<TProperty>() with ThenInclude/ThenIncludeCollection
- AsTracking() - Explicit tracking enable
- AsNoTrackingWithIdentityResolution() - No tracking with identity resolution
- ApplyDistinct() - Return distinct results
- ApplyLimit(count) - Limit results without pagination
- ClearOrdering() - Reset ordering
- TagWith(tag) - Query tagging for debugging
- FindWithSelectorAsync() - Execute specification with built-in selector
- FindPagedAsync() - Returns IPaginate from specification
- FirstOrDefaultAsync(spec) / SingleOrDefaultAsync(spec) - Single entity from spec
- FirstOrDefaultAsync<TResult>(spec, selector) - Projected single entity from spec

NEW QUERY METHODS:
- SingleOrDefaultAsync(predicate, includes, disableTracking) - Get exactly one entity
- AnyAsync(predicate?) - Check existence with optional predicate

CURSOR-BASED PAGINATION:
- GetCursorPagedAsync() - Efficient pagination for large datasets
- GetCursorPagedAsync<TResult>() - Cursor pagination with projection
- ICursorPaginate<T, TCursor> interface
- HasNext/HasPrevious, FirstCursor/LastCursor support

⚡ IMPROVEMENTS:
- IDomainRepository.GetByIdAsync now defaults to disableTracking=false
- IDomainRepository.GetByIdRequiredAsync now defaults to disableTracking=false
- Projection queries automatically use AsNoTracking for performance
- Type-safe ThenInclude via Include/IncludeCollection builder pattern
- IncludeExpressionInfo for advanced include chain tracking

🔧 BREAKING CHANGES:
- IDomainRepository.GetByIdAsync default changed: disableTracking true → false
- IDomainRepository.GetByIdRequiredAsync default changed: disableTracking true → false
- If you relied on previous defaults, explicitly pass disableTracking: true
